CVE-2025-47268.title: iputils: Signed Integer Overflow in Timestamp Multiplication in iputils ping
CVE-2025-47268.description: A flaw was found in iputils ping, where a signed integer overflow occurs in timestamp multiplication. This issue could lead to incorrect timestamp calculations or denial of service when processing crafted ICMP Echo Reply packets.

CVE-2025-48964.title: iputils: iputils integer overflow
CVE-2025-48964.description: An integer overflow flaw has been discovered in the ping function within the iputils package. This overflow may allow an attacker to craft an ECHO reply which can prevent iputils from operating normally.
